decision.rationale: The confirmed SMS latency spike and suspected AI traffic-management model involvement constitute a significant degradation of a public telecommunications service. I will report to the telecom regulator, request incident-status information from the regulator, and continue investigating the network fault. I do not yet know the confirmed root cause or whether patient health data is involved.

citations.quote_span: a licensed telecom operator reports to the telecom regulator any network incident that significantly degrades a public telecommunications service, within 60 minutes of becoming aware of it.
citations.relevance: Supports reporting the confirmed SMS latency spike and suspected model-related cause to the telecom regulator.

citations.quote_span: the telecom regulator may request from a licensed operator information about a network incident affecting a public telecommunications service.
citations.relevance: Supports requesting information from the regulator about the incident and any related determinations.

uncertainty: Root cause of the SMS latency spike is not confirmed; the model deprioritisation is only suspected.
Whether any patient health data or health-service impact is involved is unknown.
Whether the regulator has additional incident information or determinations is unknown.
